title: Expand the cubic
text: Notice that the argument in the first logarithm is a perfect cube. We can apply repeated distribution in two steps: $$\left(x-2\right)^2=x^2-4x+4$$ \n $$\left(x^2-4x+4\right) \left(x-2\right)=x^3-4x^2+4x+\left(-2x^2+8x-8\right)=x^3-6x^2+12x-8$$

title: Substitute the factored form
text: Substitute this factored form back into the expression: $$\log_5((x-2)**3)-\log_5(x-2)$$

title: Apply the law of logarithms for quotients
text: Use the law for quotients $$\log_b(a)-\log_b(c)=\log_b(a/c)$$ to combine the terms: $$\log_5\left(\frac{(x-2)**3}{x-2}\right)$$

title: Cancel common factors
text: Cancel the common factor of $$(x-2)$$ in the numerator and denominator to simplify the fraction: $$\log_5((x-2)**2).$$ Therefore, $$P(x)=\left(x-2\right)^2$$
